import os, sys
from PIL import Image

root = "/app/caffe/data/cifar10/cifar10"
out = "/app/caffe/data/cifar10/cifar-10-batches-bin"
os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
classes = ["airplane", "automobile", "bird", "cat", "deer",
           "dog", "frog", "horse", "ship", "truck"]

def write_batch(split, batch_name, per_class):
    buf = bytearray()
    count = 0
    for label, cname in enumerate(classes):
        cdir = os.path.join(root, split, cname)
        names = sorted(os.listdir(cdir))[:per_class]
        assert len(names) == per_class, (split, cname, len(names))
        for name in names:
            im = Image.open(os.path.join(cdir, name)).convert("RGB")
            assert im.size == (32, 32), im.size
            data = im.tobytes()
            buf.append(label)
            buf += data[0::3]
            buf += data[1::3]
            buf += data[2::3]

import io, os, tarfile
from PIL import Image

tgz = "/app/caffe/data/cifar10/cifar10.tgz"
out = "/app/caffe/data/cifar10/cifar-10-batches-bin"
os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
classes = ["airplane", "automobile", "bird", "cat", "deer",
           "dog", "frog", "horse", "ship", "truck"]
cidx = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}

train = [bytearray() for _ in range(5)]
test = bytearray()
counts = {c: 0 for c in classes}
n = 0

with tarfile.open(tgz, "r|gz") as tar:
    for m in tar:
        if not m.isfile() or not m.name.endswith(".png"):
            continue
        parts = m.name.split("/")
        # cifar10/{train,test}/{class}/{file}.png
        split, cname = parts[-3], parts[-2]
        if cname not in cidx:

        d = im.tobytes()
        rec = bytes([cidx[cname]]) + d[0::3] + d[1::3] + d[2::3]

    d = im.tobytes()
    return split, cname, bytes([cidx[cname]]) + d[0::3] + d[1::3] + d[2::3]
